nom: The Crème Shop Hello Kitty and Friends Dewy Peachy Shaking Toner

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are consistently positive about the hydration effect, describing relief for dry, flaky, or winter-stressed skin and for dry patches around the T-zone and lips, though one dry-skin reviewer found it more greasy than genuinely hydrating and rated it only 3 stars.
segments.combination: The one reviewer who mentions combination skin reports no issues, using the toner as makeup prep and on her dry patches.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several reviewers without a stated reaction warn other sensitive or scent-sensitive people away because of the peach fragrance, and one reports a small reaction to the scent, while reviewers who do identify as having sensitive skin say it hasn't broken them out and, in one case, that it calms redness.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying as having normal skin found the fragrance too strong and noticed little difference from using the toner.

concerns.dehydration: Dehydration is the concern most reviewers speak to: the toner is widely described as hydrating dry, flaky, or winter-stressed skin, including dry patches around the T-zone and lips, though a couple of reviewers say they noticed no real difference in hydration or texture.
concerns.redness: The one reviewer who addresses redness specifically says the toner calms it, on skin she describes as otherwise reactive ('finicky').
concerns.barrier: Two reviewers connect the toner to the skin barrier: one credits its panthenol and hyaluronic acid for letting her layer it safely on exfoliation or retinal-use days, and another titles her review around it fixing her skin barrier, though she describes the effect mainly as better glow and smoothness.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including some with sensitive or combination skin, report the toner has not caused breakouts; none report it clearing existing blemishes.
concerns.oiliness: Oiliness is the toner's most common complaint: several reviewers describe a greasy or oily finish, especially when the bottle isn't shaken thoroughly before use, while others report the opposite — that it absorbs without any oily or sticky residue.

aspects.libelle: Fragrance strength bothers sensitive or scent-sensitive users
Generous bottle size for the price

extraits.texte: This is just too scented for someone with normal skin, let alone someone with sensitive skin. I am not a fan of this at all. i didnt see much of any difference using this product

I was giving this product for free for my honest opinion. There's a visible difference from your dry face and when you use this, your face definitely shines more. Feels a little greasy after applying it to your face. The toner does have a bubble soap smell to it. The pink packaging is cute though and the toner liquid looks shiny when you pour it out. For me it doesn't give that moisture refreshing feeling but it does feel like oil to the touch. Absorbs fine after a bit.

I love that it has so many good ingredients in it like Panthenol (for barrier repair) and Hyaluronic Acid ( for hydration). Great step before moisturizer and love that it doesn't have any ingredients that clash with others. So, whatever day I'm on if I'm exfoliating or using retinal, I can use this toner to hydrate and protect my skin.

I was so excited to be able to try this toner because it is sooo cutesy and I'm a huge Hello Kitty fan! I typically have super dry skin and this product has been an absolute game changer for me. You do have to shake it extremely well to get it to properly mix though! It has a soft scent and texture, it's easy to apply and leaves a glowing, smooth finish. Just be mindful of how much of the product you are applying, because it can very easily leave your face a little TOO oily and takes a little while to fully absorb. I'd highly recommend this product to anyone who, like me, could use the extra help with hydration and oils!

I wasn't sure what to expect from a shaking toner, but this one completely won me over! The Hello Kitty® and Friends Dewy Peach Shaking Toner is not only adorable on my vanity, but surprisingly effective. The first thing you notice is the light, peachy scent—it's fresh, fruity, and not overpowering. After shaking the bottle, the formula blends into a silky, milky toner that feels instantly cooling on the skin. It absorbs quickly and leaves my face soft, hydrated, and lightly dewy without feeling sticky. I also love how gentle it is. My skin can be finicky, but this toner calms redness and works well under both moisturizer and makeup. The packaging is a bonus—cute, fun, and so on-brand for Hello Kitty fans. If you want something that's hydrating, soothing, and smells amazing, this is a must-try. It's become my go-to step after cleansing, and honestly… it just makes my routine a little happier.

extraits.titre: Very nice, leaves face shining with no break outs
extraits.texte: I use this usually after I shower and about to go out. Before, I was just applying regular lotion to my face l, but now apply this toner then apply lotion. This has made a big difference. The only thing is that I had a hard time opening the bottle. Also you must remember to shake it before every use, otherwise it will not feel good. I also have sensitive skin and this product has luckily not broken me out. Also doesn't really smell like much!

I have combo skin, and I haven't had any issues! It's more of a viscous toner. So it's great as makeup prep and my dry spots. I'm not a huge fan of scented products but the scent doesn't hurt my nose or irritate my face.
